title: AC-Hunter 04: Client Signature, User-Agent & TLS JA3/JA4 Fingerprint Anomalies
description: Replicates AC-Hunter Client Signature hunting by identifying rare or weaponized HTTP User-Agents (Nuclei, screenconnect-relay, Go-http-client), anomalous TLS JA3/JA4 client hello fingerprints, and mismatched client signatures across internal assets.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Network Firewall Logs') and ('User Agent' like '*Nuclei*' or 'User Agent' like '*screenconnect*' or 'User Agent' like '*Go-http-client*' or 'User Agent' like '*ja3*' or msg like '*ja3_hash*' or msg like '*client_signature*') | stats count as signature_hits, distinctcount('User Agent') as distinct_signatures, distinctcount('Request URL') as targeted_endpoints by 'Client IP', 'User Agent', 'Host Name', 'Trace ID' | where signature_hits >= 1 | sort -signature_hits

ask_ai_prompts: Which rare User-Agents or TLS JA3/JA4 fingerprints appeared across WAF and Application logs?
Are any internal hosts presenting multiple mismatched client signatures?

falsepositives: Authorized DevOps automation scripts using Go-http-client or python-requests
investigation_notes: Inspect weaponized User-Agents (Nuclei/3.3.0, screenconnect-relay, Go-http-client/1.1) and TLS JA3/JA4 fingerprints.
Correlate Client IP with VCN Flow and OCI Audit activity.
